title: Move Gauntlet
prompt: Implement a forwarding factory and an NRVO builder so the counters prove zero accidental copies.

tests.name: factory forwards rvalue with exactly one move
tests.hint: new Tracked(std::move(t)) — exactly one move from the by-value parameter into the pointee.

tests.name: builder uses NRVO: zero copies, zero moves
tests.hint: Construct a local from std::string(4, 'x') and return it by name — no std::move in the return.
